title: Source register
description: data/sources.json. Registers every work this dataset may cite, at two levels: collections (the Poetic Edda, the Prose Edda) and the individual works within them (Vǫluspá, Gylfaginning). Entities attest to collections; relations cite works and loci. ONLY PUBLIC-DOMAIN EDITIONS may be registered here, and no text from them is ever reproduced in this repository.

kind.description: A `collection` groups `work`s. Relations may only cite works.

partOf.description: Required on works: the id of the collection this work belongs to.

date.description: Approximate date of composition or compilation, as a human-readable string. These texts do not have precise dates and the schema should not pretend otherwise.

locusUnit.description: What a `locus` counts on this work. Required on works; the interface renders 'ch. 34' or 'st. 40' from it.

translation.description: The public-domain translation this project cites by. Required on collections.

url.description: A stable link to the full public-domain text.
